title: CheckInEvent (evidence; append-only; sync op visit.checkin)

id.description: Client UUIDv7. Idempotency key: resends are duplicates, never conflicts.

planned_stop_id.description: null = unplanned visit; first-class, flagged, never rejected.

out_of_radius_reason.description: Required by the client UX when distance > effective radius; the server never rejects for radius (ADR-0004).

trigger.description: Design 0001 §4: AUTO_GEOFENCE = dwell-matcher-emitted. Trigger mix is an analytics signal.

nearby_candidates.description: Other assigned CSPs whose effective radius also contained the fix (dense-market overlap; design 0001 §4).

description: Server derives per event: distance_from_master_m, geofence_result (INSIDE | OUTSIDE_FLAGGED), against the location coordinate version valid at capture time. Derived values live on the Visit read model, never mutate the event.
